# fastlite

> SQLite を Python から扱う開発者向けに、テーブル・カラムのオートコンプリートや dataclass との統合など快適な操作性を薄いラッパーで提供するライブラリ。

## Guide

- [Source](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastlite/blob/main/nbs/00_core.ipynb): Source code for fastlite
- [fastlite](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastlite/blob/main/nbs/index.ipynb): A bit of extra usability for sqlite
- [Test Insert Operations](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastlite/blob/main/nbs/test_insert.ipynb): Note: Make sure to use fastlite's database() here
- [Test Update Operations](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastlite/blob/main/nbs/test_update.ipynb): Note: Make sure to use fastlite's database() here
- [Test Upsert Operations](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastlite/blob/main/nbs/test_upsert.ipynb): Note: Make sure to use fastlite's database() here
